card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.

mechanism: A sends B to test an invisible bridge first and escalates from detecting a surface to testing support.
confusable: Unlike simply assigning an impossible task, A requests practical actions capable of gathering evidence about the claim.
comparison: A basket supplies a proposed load test; the tap scene changes its output to avoid tasting.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
